notes.title: Progress Report #180 - September 2025
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/af214d6e0e08133efd3dff808df58a48094cab95.png"][/img][/p][p][i][b]We regularly update our timelines with some of the more "explicitly" NSFW content over at our Discord and Twitter.[/b][/i][/p][h3][i][b]Find us at:[/b][/i][/h3][h3]Twitter: [url="https://x.com/CursedAtelier"]@CursedAtelier[/url][/h3][h3]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/tG7DKBa"]https://discord.com/invite/tG7DKBa[/url][/h3][hr][/hr][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]It’s that time again~ Here’s a fresh look at what we’ve been working on these past few days.[/p][p]---🎨----[/p][p]The Goblin artwork has received some revisions and a pinch of extra polish. Don’t let their "charming" home fool you though- these little tricksters are as crafty as they come.[/p][p]The Orc Dungeon’s Kitchen Map is getting some enhanced attention, with new furniture and object details added to bring the ambience alive.[/p][p]Speaking of kitchen, our artist is having wayyy too much fun with 3D modeling, crafting props and set pieces for the dungeon, including unique elements that will add flair to the map 👇[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/b4984716a106dbef9dad664b35fc845453946601.png"][/img][/p][p]Lastly, fresh cut-ins for both Goblins and Orcs are underway, alongside lineart for some nasty traps that are bound to keep Caly on her toes. We hope you'll keep her safe![/p][p]----✍️----[/p][p]We’re down to the last 20% of writing and editing for the Orc Dungeon’s main story. Almost there![/p][p]Once that’s wrapped up, our writer will shift focus to the next leg of the main storyline as well as the steamy erotic events tied to the Orc Dungeon.[/p][p]Keep an eye out for previews and teasers along the way. Let’s just say these upcoming scenes are shaping up to be very delicious indeed.[/p][p]----🖥️----[/p][p]News from the Tech Corner: Work continues on systems that will allow us to expand the Arcade with new games on its upcoming second floor.[/p][p]Omni-directional movement programming is in progress, paving the way for smoother and more flexible player navigation. Dodging those grabby NPCs will be a tad bit easier now- if you want to that is 😏[/p][p]Finally, research is underway on implementing parallax map scrolling, which could give our map environment extra layer of depth and visual flair.[/p][p]-----------[/p][p]That’s the roundup for this week![/p][p]As always, thank you for tuning in for the weekly update! We’ll be back next week with more progress to share.[/p][p]Until then, stay curious and stay adventurous, VoidSeekers![/p][p]Kind Regards,[/p][p]Cursed-Atelier Team[/p][p][u][i]Find Us @[/i] [/u][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500710/VoidBound/V"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/ba80489e6f3d70860e31b2b9cc011ff6c6a03df0.png"][/img][/p][p][i][b]We regularly update our timelines with some of the more "explicitly" NSFW content over at our Discord and Twitter.[/b][/i][/p][h3][i][b]Find us at:[/b][/i][/h3][h3]Twitter: [url="https://x.com/CursedAtelier"]@CursedAtelier[/url][/h3][h3]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/tG7DKBa"]https://discord.com/invite/tG7DKBa[/url][/h3][hr][/hr][p]Voidsurfers,[/p][p]This week’s development efforts continue steadily across art, story, and coding, with a mix of fresh updates and ongoing refinements. Here's a quick review:[/p][p]---🎨----[/p][p]Work on the Goblin Dungeon’s 2nd floor has begun! The little green troublemakers have set up camp near the kitchen. The question is, will stealth be enough to slip through their hostile turf?[/p][p]A brand-new cover image resource is also in the works, adding another piece to the game’s visual identity.[/p][p]Our new VoidBound banner is nearly wrapped up, with rendering as the final step before it’s ready to shine.[/p][p]----✍️----[/p][p]The Orc Mission dialogue is getting a full polish pass, with facial expressions being applied across every conversation, big or small, for added impact.[/p][p]Minor story portions are being revised to better align with the evolving Goblin Map.[/p][p]Work has started on brainstorming and drafting options for an upcoming Special Poll, where players will help decide the next planet Caly sets foot on in the Main Story.[/p][p]----🖥️----[/p][p]Work continued on this week with troubleshooting the Caching System. Stability still remains elusive, but we're confident we're inching closer to a solution with each attempt![/p][p]Also brainstorming fresh combat mechanics for the Orc Dungeon, aiming to make it a dynamic adventure rather than just blasting enemies and moving on.[/p][p]Finally, early theorizing has begun on a new weapon/tool that players will be able to discover within the dungeon itself.[/p][p]-----------[/p][p]That’s the latest from our end! With maps expanding, stories tightening, and new plans taking shape, the galaxy of VoidBound keeps getting bigger and bolder.[/p][p]Stay tuned, for more adventures are always just around the corner.[/p][p]Kind Regards,[/p][p]Cursed-Atelier Team[/p][p][u][i]Find Us @[/i] [/u][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500710/VoidBound/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🎮 VoidBound 0.6.8 - Game On! The Arcade Awaits 🕹️
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/f02d92a4e230cee24350d03733cb89c5d3ca7676.png"][/img]
🎮 VoidBound 0.6.8 - Game On! The Arcade Awaits 🕹️

The wait is over![/p][p]The Arcade floor is officially open, bringing a fresh wave of minigames filled with challenges, and rewards to spice up your VoidBound experience.[/p][p]This update delivers a new ways to play and test your skills while stacking those tickets, and unlocking some sweet prizes along the way. Ready to dive in? Then head here![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/00323535733e7acebcbd4ff8fba7d2d6c481157e.jpg"][/img][b][u]Content Highlights:[/u][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/32c157bfe0dba7a7139f5ddefd66c533ad7ca0bb.jpg"][/img]🎫[b]Henosian Arcade[/b]🎫[/p][p]Step into the Arcade, a vibrant hub packed with two interactive minigames that let you put your skills(and luck) to the test. Rack up tickets, unlock exclusive rewards, and experience a whole new way to enjoy VoidBound beyond the battlefield.[/p][p]⦁	[b][u]Let the Rhythm flow[/u][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/688bc252dc1b6344d31117b3746a0c0c8cad5ea9.gif"][/img]Hit the beat and match the arrows in this DDR-inspired rhythm challenge![/p][p]Featuring 4 tracks straight from VoidBound, difficulty ranges from Easy to Extreme for all skill levels. Each session costs 250 credits, but play well and watch Caly shed a layer turning up the heat as your score climbs! Tickets earned differ based on your performance so play and find out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/02f38e42f0cfd2f63441f9add03a666b22c96704.gif"][/img]Our Advice? Start on Easy to get used to the layout and speed > Not necessary, but a game-pad will make things easier and your fingers/arms will thank you for it > Enjoy the vibes :)[/p][p]⦁	[b][i][u]Crackshot Caly[/u][/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/58be7612860ddbf83c5bbf2d13743402d692bd10.gif"][/img][i]Sharpen your aim in this fast-paced target challenge![/i][/p][p][i]With three difficulty tiers, you’ll face eight moving targets- each faster and trickier than the last. Higher levels bring a devious twist: some targets vanish, leaving only a pale reflection, your memory and reflexes to guide your shots. Entry costs 50, 100, or 150 Credits depending on the challenge you choose! Win and walk away with a cool 99, 249 or 499 Tickets respectively. Lose and... tough luck :S[/i][/p][p][i]High Risk, High Reward![/i][/p][p]Our Advice? Start on Easy to learn patterns > Don't smash the trigger recklessly > Aim true, predict precisely and make your shots count 🎯[/p][p][b]<Trade the Tickets in at the Front Desk>[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/f8c5050bc141f5d7f17e4bfaf1cde71fad441210.png"][/img][i]Rack up those tickets and cash in for some truly exclusive loot![/i][/p][p][i]The Arcades aren't about being fair- it’s about bragging rights and hard-earned rewards. From the speedy Zoomies Energy Bar to the combat-changing Lag Bomb, every prize packs a punch. Feeling lucky? There’s even a one-of-a-kind Lucky Token promising big stat boosts- though we can’t guarantee how ‘lucky’ it really is.[/i][/p][p][i]And for the curious, an enigmatic Arcade Keycard awaits those who dare to splurge. Just remember: the best prizes come at a price… and you’ll need more than a few rounds to claim them all! Not to mention they're limited in quantity(for now)![/i][/p][p]------------------------[/p][p][b]-Change Log:-[/b][/p][p]🔹 New Content: 💡[/p][p]⦁	Arcade Overhaul. New Map, New Layout, New Avenues for fun![/p][p]⦁	New mini game: DJ Caly Rhythm game.[/p][p]⦁	It will feature 4 Tracks with Easy, Normal and Hard Difficulties. Lovense integration planned, but currently disabled.[/p][p]⦁	New mini game: Crackshot[/p][p]⦁	Features shooting 8 distinct patterned targets made more unique across three difficulty curves: Easy, Normal and Hard.[/p][p]⦁	A new Ticket Store featuring items, unique to the Arcade only, that you can get by trading in the tickets you receive from the new mini games.[/p][p][b]🔹 In-Game Fixes: 🛠️[/b][/p][p]⦁	Various bug and grammar fixes.[/p][p][b]🔹 Ongoing Fixes: ⌨️[/b][/p][p]⦁	Lovense for new content not properly implemented.[/p][p]⦁	Caching system is too broken to be included.[/p][p]------------------------[/p][p][b]The Arcade is officially open for business, but this is just one floor![/b][/p][p]More games, new challenges, and an expanded prize pool are already on our roadmap. So dive in, rack up those tickets, and enjoy the first wave of fun while we keep building the ultimate entertainment hub. More is yet to come![/p][p]Kind Regards,[/p][p][b]Cursed Atelier Team[/b][/p][p][/p]

Maps, story beats, and gameplay tweaks- let’s dive in![/p][p]---🎨----[/p][p]The Prison map for the Orc dungeon is taking shape, designed to hold all manner of captives and fitted with an assortment of containment devices. notes.title: Progress Report #174 - August 2025
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/0e842526e38272d2b26f35d47cd2e5cb575799f5.png"][/img][/p][h3][b][i]We regularly update our timelines with some of the more "explicitly" NSFW content over at our Discord and Twitter.[/i][/b][/h3][h3][b][i]Find us at:[/i][/b][/h3][h3]Twitter: [url="https://x.com/CursedAtelier"]@CursedAtelier[/url][/h3][h3]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/tG7DKBa"]https://discord.com/invite/tG7DKBa[/url][/h3][hr][/hr][p]Hey everyone~[/p][p]With August rolling in, it's time for another fresh dive into the current state of development.[/p][p]From new maps and mechanics to ongoing story work and feature upgrades, the team's been steadily pushing forward.[/p][p]---🎨----[/p][p]The Orc dungeon continues to take shape with several key areas now mapped out. The Cargo Bay and Smelter sections are fully completed, while work on the Prison area is actively underway.[/p][p]In parallel, several in-game objects have been designed and refined. Elements like a detailed milking device, modular prison cell structures, energy batteries and many more have all been modeled and processed in CSP to ensure they’re ready for integration in-game.[/p][p]----✍️----[/p][p]Writing and editing efforts remain focused on fleshing out the Orc dungeon’s narrative content. The tone, pacing, and dialogue are all being sharpened to fit the grimy, lust-filled atmosphere players can expect from this storyline.[/p][p]----🖥️----[/p][p]Multiple fronts are in motion. First, we’re expanding our existing mini-games by introducing new difficulty modes, giving players more variety and challenge.[/p][p]An important mini-game plugin is slightly behind our initial estimates, but still progressing smoothly. Background animations are now being added to bring more life to the experience, syncing visual flair with the beats.[/p][p]Asset implementation has also ramped up thanks to recent layout organization. Everything’s sorted, and being brought into the project layer by layer.[/p][p]Additionally, a dedicated testing mode for GUI elements is nearly complete. This internal tool will let us iterate faster by making interface elements modifiable on the fly.[/p][p]Lastly, work on the Orc dungeon framework continues steadily, handling both the layout logic and functional event systems that will drive its gameplay.[/p][p]-----------[/p][p]And that’s all for this round~[/p][p]While some parts are still in progress, momentum remains strong across the board. And we hope to pick up the pace further in the coming few days.[/p][p]Till then though, stay safe and stay awesome![/p][p]Kind Regards,[/p][p]Cursed-Atelier Team[/p][p][i][u]Find Us @[/u][/i][u] [/u][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500710/VoidBound/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🎮 VoidBound 0.6.7 Beta Release - Exhibition Mode Unveiled
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/9d582d3471234c5e0001fcaa937f72443cf5e540.png"][/img]
It’s time to bare it all- [b]literally![/b][/p][p]We’re proud to finally roll out [b]VoidBound 0.6.7[/b] for our STEAM community! This update marks a bold new addition to Caly's journey: the debut of the [b]Exhibition Mode-[/b] a feature that lets players [i]fully[/i] embrace Caly’s confidence and flaunt it across Henosis.[/p][h3]

For Players Continuing with Old Saves:[/h3][p][i]To access the new quest "An Unexpected invitation", you must have completed:[/i][/p][p]1) The entire Xaide main quest-line culminating with the quest [b]"A Not So Distant Memory"[/b] where Caly wakes up from her coma.[/p][p]2) You must also have paid a visit to the Auction House and participated in the vase auction event.[/p][p]If you've already finished these, head to [b]Mr. Fixer[/b] in Caly's room and select: ➡️ [b]"Trigger New Content > 0.6.7"[/b] From there, choose the quest "An Unexpected Invitation".[/p][p][i]Either way, once the player has the quest active, they must zone into the Elite district, walk a few steps forward and then make a u-turn again to try and exit back to the Commercial District. The quest will auto trigger at this point.[/i][/p][p]⚠️ [b]WARNING: Do not use this feature if you haven’t completed the prerequisite quests. Doing so may break your game and save![/b][/p][p]
[b]Content Highlights:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/2d7d13582da841dfe40152483d5f82cdd644cceb.png"][/img][/p][p]🔥 Exhibition Mode 🔥[/p][p]If Caly’s gotten her fair share of “hands-on” adventures and built up that [b]Body Confidence by engaging in plenty of erotic events,[/b] you’ll now unlock the option to explore in the nude. Whether she’s strolling through the main commercial district or teasing the locals of the slums with nothing but shapely curves, the choice is all yours.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/8b0e21bccd07ccd1043c2ee06589021fad774960.png"][/img]
Expect a range of [b]NPC[/b] reactions, from shocked stares to saucy comments, all depending on how much horny they're feeling in the moment. And believe us when we state this: Some of them are not going to be satisfied with just staring. They will pursue.. [b]relentlessly[/b] 🙌[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/09783ad3b75b19a5e25b04dd416dd6feb6d9fab5.png"][/img][/p][p]🔧 [b]Note on Exhibition Mode:[/b][/p][p]This is just the [b]first phase[/b] of the Exhibition Mode system. While Henosis is the starting point, we're not ruling out plans to expand and [b]evolve this feature[/b] further in future updates. More locations, more reactions, and more interactive heat if ideas align! Think of this as the foundation, not the ceiling. 😉[/p][p]-----------[/p][p]Our favorite Martian mercenary finds herself back on Xaide again, accepting a job to recover [b]rare eggs from an exotic plant:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/5c384c5e52e40a98fe45fc53c5fc15f00268079d.png"][/img][/p][p]Sounds simple, right? But if Caly gets too greedy, she might discover this plant has more than just thorns to defend itself with...[/p][p]⦁	This quest has prerequisites. Player must have finished the main Xaide questline, as well as participated in the auction of the priceless vase at the Auction House in Elite District.[/p][p]⦁	A new sub map has been added that is going to serve as an extension of the Auction House itself, housing some priceless artifacts on display.[/p][p]⦁	Once the quest is available, [b]players can request to visit the display exhibit freely.[/b][/p][p]⦁	Let’s just say this quest gets messier if she insists on pushing her luck. And yes, plenty of [b]lewd consequences[/b] await.[/p][p]------------------------[/p][p][/p][p]-Change Log:-[/p][p]🔹 New Content: 💡[/p][p]⦁	✅ [b]New Questline Added[/b] : Dive into a fresh side adventure featuring a certain exotic (and dangerously grabby) plant on Xaide.[/p][p]⦁	🔞 [b]1 New H-Scene[/b] : Expect consequences if Caly gets too greedy.[/p][p]⦁	🎭 [b]9 Exhibition Cut-in Images[/b] – Visual reactions to Caly’s boldness have been brought to life with brand new artwork.[/p][p]⦁	🎨 [b]36 New Sprites[/b] – Includes artifacts, paintings, and sculptures to enrich the Auction House's ambience.[/p][p]⦁	🖼️ [b]New System Graphics[/b] – UI and system elements got a visual update.[/p][p]⦁	🧠 [b]Enemy Patrol AI Rewritten[/b] – The entire enemy patrol logic has been rebuilt for smoother, more dynamic behavior.[/p][p]⦁	💡 [b]Lighting System Overhauled[/b] – Improved performance and visual fidelity in key areas of the game.[/p][p]⦁	🗣️ [b]60+ New Catcall Lines[/b] – NPCs across Henosis have lots to say about Caly showing off her skin.[/p][p]⦁	🧩 [b]Multi-Branched Dialogue in Exhibition Mode[/b] : Some will go beyond than just saying, with their actions fondling louder than words.[/p][p]⦁	🧍‍♀️ [b]New NPCs for Exhibition Mode[/b] – More gawkers, admirers, and commentators populate the world.[/p][p]⦁	🫦 Birthday Suit Unlocked – Once your Body Confidence stat is high enough, you can now opt to go au naturel and activate Exhibition Mode.
[/p][p]🔹 [b]In-Game Fixes:[/b] 🛠️[/p][p]⦁	Fixed game freeze after intro.[/p][p]⦁	Fixed Hangar Official repeating both his dialogue and movement route during Corbyn side quest if the player talks to the him again before he returns back to his original spot.[/p][p]⦁	Fixed an issue where entering the Embassy via Her Indulgence’s brothel route would still trigger the “Find Embassy Entrance ” popup upon entering the Residential area, even after completing the quest. This message will no longer appear, and the guard will now fully abandon his post if the scenario is resolved through this alternate path.[/p][p]⦁	Fixed double Haar sprite in his room in case players do not accept his hiking invite.[/p][p]⦁	Fixed Haar's room transition to the newly added floor, instead of one floor below it.[/p][p]⦁	Fixed Ishan still fighting Caly even after finishing the Slime Quest-line. He will now vanish after player gets access to embassy after talking to Felbig.
[/p][p]🔹 [b]Technical Fixes:[/b] 🛠️[/p][p]⦁	Updated Lovense plugins and gave the device Gush a stronger vibration curve.[/p][p]⦁	Fixed Idle vibration setting not staying active after changing menu.[/p][p]⦁	Fixed various minor bugs.[/p][p]⦁	Fixed various typos.
[/p][p]🔹 [b]Ongoing Development:[/b] ⌨️[/p][p]⦁	Updating plugins for the new caching system that is coming next update (from 6-8 average second loading time to under 1 second!!)[/p][p]⦁	Progress ongoing towards the next segment of the zone featuring "Space Orcs and Goblins".[/p][p]------------------------[/p][p]And that sums up everything for this one![/p][p]Thank you, as always, for your continued love and support. This update lets Caly show off her most daring side yet, and we hope you’ll lean into it just as boldly. Better yet, got spicy ideas to make things even hotter? Drop them here or on our Discord, because we’re always listening.[/p][p]Who knows? We just might turn up the heat a few notches for your pleasure 🔥🌌
[/p][p]Till then though~ enjoy and stay kinky,[/p][p][b]Cursed Atelier Team[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/7b94981f19b4fc5239c61e397b3968f10280c6d6.jpg[/img]

VoidSeekers 👩🏽‍🚀

We’re excited to announce that Update 0.6.6 is now live! This update pushes new scenarios, freshly minted map assets, and full integration of the Lovense system. To celebrate this milestone, we are launching this release with a 25% off discount on the 26th for a limted time!

Content Highlights:
🔧 Lovense Integration: Complete 💈
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/35ddf638033968e712ff1bc89a6792fb88debe6f.gif[/img]

[b]What is Lovense?[/b]
Lovense is a brand of smart toys designed to sync with games, apps, and other interactive media. With this integration, compatible devices respond dynamically to in-game events, scenes, and dialogues.

[b]How it works in VoidBound:[/b]
Once enabled, your Lovense toy will respond in real-time to in-game events—especially during sordidly steamy encounters and lewd twists that arise in combat. It’s fully dynamic: the toy will pulse, vibrate, or tease in perfect sync with the action on screen. Intensity, duration, and pattern shift depending on the situation, ensuring that every encounter feels uniquely personal and intimately reactive.

[b]Steps to make it work:[/b]
[i]Open your Lovense Remote App and go to Game Mode.
⦁	Enable LAN and enter your Local IP and Port (20010).
⦁	Hit Connect—if successful, the Connection Status will change to “Connected” and Connected
Devices will list as 1 (supports up to 7 devices at once).[/i]

[b]Shoutout to the pioneer: Karryn's Prison by Remtairy[/b]
Our Lovense integration wouldn’t exist without the trail blazed by Karryn’s Prison. The system we’ve developed is built on concepts pioneered by [b]Remtairy[/b], who generously gave us the go-ahead to use his work as a foundation. Huge shout out to him for sharing the framework for us to build upon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/8ac1bd36ba69527ff93ee0c42c7dd061252e2c3b.png[/img]
[i]"What the hell indeed? What was all of that?! It seems something fishy is going on in the Slums District. Players must investigate!
⦁	This quest has no prerequisites.
⦁	Remember, no good deed goes unpunished[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/b71e13d9659fa1a9bb4ba6fbaac2fb9fb3fd2801.png[/img]

[i]Uh oh- Vas is calling in a favor. This can't be good... can it?
⦁	This quest becomes available after completing the Looking for Slimes and Jem's Lost Cargo quest line.
⦁	As Part 1 of an ongoing chain, Caly is set on a wild chase to track down an acquaintance, one that Caly might have a sordid history with, and by proxy get a glimpse into how Vas operates in her mercenary world.[/i]

[b]For Players Continuing with Old Saves:[/b]
[i]To access the new quest "Hidden Threat", you must first complete [b]"The Slime Saga" by either siding with the HDF or the Slimes. Additionally,[/b] you also need to [b]have setup your rig[from Jem's Lost Cargo quest-line] and stream from your room at least once.[/b]
If you've already finished these, head to [b]Mr. Fixer[/b] in Caly's room and select: ➡️ [b]"Trigger New Content > 0.6.6"[/b] From there, choose the quest "Hidden Threat".
⚠️ [b]WARNING:[/b] Do not use this feature if you haven’t completed the prerequisite quests. Doing so may break your game and save![/i]

[b]-Change Log:-[/b]
🔹 [b]New Content:[/b]
⦁	Game is now fully Lovense compatible, including effects during both events as well as combat.
⦁	Added a new [b]questline featuring Caly and Vas.[/b]
⦁	Added a new [b]Slum Trap[/b] scenario.
⦁	Introduced [b]one new H-scene.[/b]

🔹[b] Fixes & Adjustments:[/b]
⦁	Fixed softlock on two doors in Haar's Apartment building.
⦁	Fixed Caly momentarily sliding into an inaccessible room in Haar's Apartment building.
⦁	Fixed double Haar sprites if players turn down Haar's Hiking offer and pick up the BigTrouble quest at the same.
⦁	Fixed an issues in rare cases where players would get duplicate of Wild Branches in Xaide dungeon.
⦁	Fixed an issue where if players left the Evidence room and went to the Residential District instead of the police station during the quest "Deputy for a night", Varyn would not show up at his seat.

🔹 [b]Ongoing Development:[/b]
⦁	Working on the next segment of the game featuring "Space Orcs and Goblins"

And that is everything for this update. As always, your feedback helps make VoidBound better, so please be sure to let us know what you think down below or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/tG7DKBa]Discord![/url]
Fair winds, spacers! 🚀

- Cursed-Atelier Team

notes.title: 🎮 VoidBound 0.6.5 Release 💝
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/8d34468162d8c235e43a12df5073fbb3b904374f.png[/img]
[b]Fresh Update Inbound[/b] ❤️✨

Love may have filled the air on Valentine's, but now it's [b]Steam's turn to join the fun![/b] The [b]VoidBound 0.6.5 update[/b] has arrived—packed with fixes, improvements, and even a bit of fantasizing to keep the mood alive. 😉

Check out the full changelog for all the details.
[i]
[b]For Players Continuing with Old Saves:[/b]
To access the new quests, you must first complete [b]"Deputy For A Night"[/b] and [b]"Virog Char, the Brute of Henosis"[/b] quests.[/i]

[i]If you've already finished these, head to [b]Mr. Fixer[/b] in Caly's room and select: ➡️ [b]"Trigger New Content [0.6.5]"[/b]
From there, choose the relevant quests based on your progress.
[/i]
⚠️ [u][b]WARNING:[/b] Do not use this feature if you haven’t completed the prerequisite quests. Doing so may break your game and save![/u]

[u][b]Content Highlights:[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/261aa1bf5cf5afd9ad5f86329cbb770f96ba8212.png[/img]
[i]Haar has gone radio silent, and Jens is starting to worry. Fortunately, Caly has just wrapped up a task and is more than happy to check in on him![/i]

[list]
[*]This quest becomes available after completing the [b]Pharmacy Heists Investigation[/b] questline.
[*]As part of an ongoing chain, this mission sets the stage for Caly’s deeper dive into the [b]Henosis underworld[/b], with key elements unfolding in the epilogue.
[/list]

[i]Originally a temporary debug feature for niche issues, [b]Mr. Fixer[/b] now offers [b]broader usability[/b] to help players resolve various in-game problems.[/i]

[list]

For instance, some players have reported receiving [b]duplicate Xaide branches[/b] instead of five unique ones. While we’re still investigating the cause, [b]Mr. Fixer[/b] can now correct this issue for affected players.
[*]Additionally,[b] Mr. Fixer now serves as a content trigger too,[/b] allowing players continuing from older saves to unlock new content—provided they’ve completed the necessary prerequisite questlines.

🔹 [b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new [b]questline featuring Caly and Haar.[/b]
[*]Added a new [b]holo-pregnancy questline.[/b]
[*]Introduced [b]one new H-scene.[/b]

[list]

[*]Fixed [b]various grammar issues.[/b]
[*]Adjusted and fixed the [b]vision cone system[/b] for slime enemies.
[*]Fixed an issue where a [b]weapon mod[/b] could be purchased more than once.
[*]Assigned [b]sell values[/b] to all weapon mods to prevent duplicate clutter.
[/list]

🔹 [b]Ongoing Development:[/b]
[list]
[*]Began preparations for the [b]upcoming Lovense update.[/b]
[/list]

----------

This update fine-tunes several areas of the game while pushing us closer to our next big milestone. As always, your feedback helps shape the experience, so be sure to let us know what you think on the STEAM community hub or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/tG7DKBa]Discord![/url]

[b]Greetings VoidBound Community![/b]

We’re thrilled to share some exciting news—our latest game update 0.6.4 is finally ready! 

This update introduces a new branch in the story, sending Caly on a quest to recover a stolen consignment. What begins as a simple retrieval mission quickly escalates into something far more exciting—complete with investigations, naughty collectibles, and a path to internet stardom for our daring heroine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/254dc12df40f1ab0c690b3fc4e78dae99d275ac5.png[/img]

[/b][list]
[*][i]Interested players, who would like to pick up her new quest,[/i][b][i]need to make sure that they have already met her at the disco in Red-light District.[/i][/b]
[*][i]Helping Jem will open up new avenues of fame for Caly, so we highly recommend checking this one out. To make things extra spicy, make sure to also pay a visit to—[/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/718d59b1bfe6704f5dad359375c742cd82b166a1.png[/img]
[b]Elma, the sex shop owner who has also expanded her services. She will now help Caly attain SIX unique "naughty" toys, provided she has what is needed:
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/c9a51181cabda460607220bb51269047a95eee70.png[/img]
[list]
[*][i]The first one can be found by simply making your first purchase at Elma's.[/i]
[*][i]One is somewhere on Tripteen. Make sure to explore every nook and cranny for those hidden chests! But, if you can't find all the pieces, perhaps Elma can help?[/i]
[*][i]Two others can be found on Xaide. Rumor has it that a certain merchant holds one and the other one is scattered in pieces all across the dense ruins.[/i]
[*][i]The last two are in Henosis. Seems like a slime has left something behind in the Embassy. Additionally, perhaps a trip to the clinic is on the books as well?[/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/c1e028b9d7533fe246c24d776627cbbb0b3585f2.png[/img]
[b]Kickstart your spicy E-Girl career. Armed with or without your trusty little toys (though it's definitely more fun with them), Caly can amass an internet following that is sure to make her a local celebrity!
[/b]

[u][b]-Change Log:-[/b][/u]

⦁	New Loading Screen Graphic.
⦁	New Jem Standing art and outfit.
⦁	Changed Hardware store into Jem's Furniture store.
⦁	Added 8 H scenes.
⦁	Updated plugins to allow for upgrades and additions to Setek.
⦁	Added a new quest line from Jem.
⦁	Added 6 collectable dildo's across the whole game.
⦁	Updated Elma in the Sex Store.
⦁	Added Dildo blueprint system.
⦁	Added a new system that will hide choices if requirements are not met yet.

[b]Developer Notes & Instructions:[/b]

1) Simply download and unzip the file and double click Game.exe to play the game.

2) If you're confused about the .7z extension, simply install the freeware 7zip software, right click on the downloaded file and hit "Extract here"(If you are on Win11, click "Show more Options" first before finding the "Extract here" command)

[b]3) Saves are backwards compatible should you decide to import your saves from the last update.[/b] Copy the save folder from the original and paste it into this one. Continue playing as normal from where you last left off.

-----------

And that is it for this one! Thank you all for your continued support this year and for being such an amazing community! We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the update down below or on our Discord!

Happy holidays and happy gaming!
Cursed-Atelier Team

notes.title: VoidBound 0.6.3 Release!
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

We're thrilled to announce that the latest content patch for VoidBound is finally ready for STEAM release!

This update brings a ton of new features, improvements, and fixes based on your feedback. Whether you're here for the expanded scenarios, combat tweaks, or shiny new additions, there's something for everyone in this patch.

Below, you'll find a curated change log with everything that’s been added, fixed, and polished.
===========

New Stories: 📖
⦁	Caly and Vas's Girl's Day Out
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/bb4e177b1ea806a70c0fe9344f885c6241dd8e40.png[/img]
A Yuri Spa Date with Vas? Sounds innocent enough... right?? Pay Vas another visit at her home in Henosis to find out!
[b][NOTE: Available AFTER completing the shower event at Vas's apartment.][/b]

⦁	An Exotic Gig 💃🏽
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/d7612ebabd476e350f42a32b49755a9e8fffd7a9.png[/img]
Deep Crimson in the Pleasure District is now hiring!
===========

New Additions: 🖌️
⦁	Complete overhaul of Haar's ship, Setek 🚀
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/e1aa36d6a5c7e10ba8473b7ceef39b3699e557b6.png[/img]
[i]And when we say overhaul, we really mean it. Check out all the new interior maps![/i]

⦁	Brand New Dialogue Box for better readability 💬
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/fd31e301ee48b2c0e95376946a15ab4f63ffccd1.gif[/img]
[i]Compact, concise and easy on the eyes![/i]

⦁	New cut ins, corresponding attacks, and unique dialogues for the Tripteen Boss!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/68fe1293626bc5669c23363a89dfbab7d2a20d7b.png[/img]
[i]How about.. no?[/i]
===========

New Gameplay Updates: 🗜️
⦁	All major quests have been added to the Quest Log Interface 📝
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/dc486831ebd2a8c74db796f56b0b8aa7fe517988.png[/img]
[i]With this, players can now easily track over 40+ quests, with more to be added in the future![/i]

Additionally (with lots of sparkles):
⦁	Enhanced the intro sequence with improved story flow and smoother movement routes. [NEW] Fixed some instances where the star sparkles would turn into circles on interaction.
⦁	Updated the Tripteen dungeon with sparkling animations for interactable objects and smoother event transitions.
⦁	[NEW] Added new environmental sounds in the Tripteen dungeon.
⦁	Refined some Henosis quests for better clarity, highlighting interactable objects, and added new switches for NPCs to offer more varied dialogue based on chosen decision path and quest progress.
⦁	Streamlined the embassy by adding object animations to highlight key items and improved visual effects for the crack in the wall.
⦁	Revised Xaide with clearer objective dialogues and sparkling effects for hard-to-spot interactables. Reworked the laser mechanics in the eastern area of the dungeon, so that players may decide how to proceed.
⦁	Polished the Mind Dungeon with sparkling effects and refined dialogues for better flow and stronger connection to the existing lore.
⦁	Added sparkling effects to most, if not all events, that can be interacted with.
⦁	[NEW] Players can now only carry a maximum of 35 Water Bottles. Additionally, the recovery rate has been reduced, making it less effective than the Trauma Pack, and it can no longer be used during combat.
⦁	Lastly, Nameplate System is now active!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/c192fa6c2c6d40adaad91a64ef19d50d5e5d1509.png[/img]
[i]A graphic pop-up will now appear when entering an area, notifying you of your current location.[/i]
===========

New Combat Updates: ⚔️
⦁	New powerful skills have been added for Caly's Blaster and SP-42. Beware though, their destructive power comes at the cost of energy and ammo, so choose wisely!
⦁	Overhauled and balanced skill sets as well as combat patterns for normal enemies in the Embassy and Xaide.
⦁	Enemy icons during combat now display numbers to easily identify the next turn order.
⦁	Crafting pages have been added for the sniper and assault rifle.
⦁	Added labels to the weapon modding page so it is easier to see at first glance which part goes where.
⦁	Raised the Orgasm limit to 2, so you can see and enjoy the graphics longer.
===========
New Fixed and Adjustments: 🩹
⦁	Fixed a bug where defeated enemies remained in an alert state after re-entering the dungeon.
⦁	Resolved a crafting bug where equipping a mod no longer displayed as 1/1.
⦁	Fixed text lag after winning combat and receiving items.
⦁	Corrected various issues in the Quest Log.
⦁	Fixed an issue preventing players from loading saved games.
⦁	Adjusted text in several bad endings for clarity.
⦁	[b][NEW][/b] Fixed Jen's Standing Art not de-spawning after the initial interaction.
⦁	[b][NEW] [/b]Miscellaneous Plugin Optimizations for improved performance.
===========
And that, wraps up the latest content patch notes.

We hope you enjoy these new additions and improvements. Feel free to share your thoughts here or on our Discord as you explore the updated world!

As always, thank you for your continued support—your faith keeps us pushing forward!

With much Appreciation and Regards,
Cursed-Atelier Team

Find Us @ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500710/VoidBound/

We're re-designing the User Interface for Weapon Modding.  As a major feature of VoidBound, we want the mechanic to be visually appealing, easy to understand, and intuitive for players.

Flat coloring for the second scene of the Henosis new content is progressing well, with the work now around 70-80% complete.

We've also completed the concept art for the Henosis bank note, adding a tangible element to the game's economy. Whether it's for the casino or other shadowy corners, this hard currency is ready to circulate.

The preliminary story draft involving Caly's new job on Henosis is near complete. Players will be offered multiple ways to approach the  narrative, with variations that'd lead to different outcomes. The choices made will also impact how the finale unfolds, adding layers of depth and replayability to the experience.

We're also reviewing the Slime vs HDF Saga. While the quest is engaging, we believe there's room for improvement by clarifying the objectives, so that branching narratives are clearer for the players.

Work is also underway to enhance the Henosian side quests by integrating more sparkly interactables. We hope that alongside the quest log, these visual cues will help players navigate around the map and the objectives.

To boost the atmosphere within dungeons, we're working on implementing new Sound Boxes. These will add an extra layer of immersion, making each dungeon exploration more intense and engaging.

Finally, development has begun on the first Casino Mini-Game. Whether you're feeling lucky or just want to unwind, this new feature will let you try your hand at winning big—but beware, you might lose all those hard-earned credits on Henosis!

Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with an eldritch entity named "Qhroth'un".

History does not tell us that Norse clans had scribes of their own. Their folklore is said to have been preserved through oral traditions exclusively, but this is not the truth. Many written sagas were damaging to the reputation of royal families and expository to the church. So these writings, along with their authors, were aggressively purged from existence. Korvald was one such scribe.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/15b48123089c8e96badd36a288b47601ddd51a32.png[/img]
Korvald's is not a tale of heroism and justice, but of deceit and suffering provoked by powerful religious empires and unseen cosmic forces. His story begins as so many are ended. Family slain and taken from his now destroyed village, Korvald is branded as a heretic and seemingly condemned to death. The true purpose of his capture and torment are part of a much bigger and far more sinister agenda. In his darkest hour, Korvald is approached by Qhroth'un and an agreement is made that will change everything...

[b]Weapons:[/b]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d85e57a15bbe676ec23009fb437e3ee78d519a6b.png[/img]

[b]I am pleased to announce the sexy space adventure Voidbound OUT NOW in early access on Steam![/b]

Curesd Atelier has been working on this story for years, and to review this game and watch it grow has been nothing short of amazing. I am thrilled that I get to be here to help bring it to the finish line.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/c4a4ef7b76cd08c87ede9093204be6801b1d2d00.png[/img]

Now the game IS in Early Access but rest assured that the team is hard at work finishing up the games core. There is already so much to explore and so many sexy things to do! What we want you to do is stay glued to the steam page for updates and check their socials which we have pinned in the discussion thread for more news and infomation.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/63809219c54f71d8b49156c6b1c227b75e4e1bc3.png[/img]

Play as Caly, a sexy adorkable space merc in VoidBound, a Sci-fi Ero tactical RPG with a dynamic combat system focusing on strategic gameplay and kinky encounters. Prepare for battle by modifying your arsenal of weapons and gadgets to bring down more and more powerful aliens, deadly robots, and much more! Explore exotic planets, discover new outfits and equipment, and find yourself entangled in the midst of an intergalactic war where your choices will leave a lasting impact on the future of the universe.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/e45defffa45e81044308a4739308cc2ae0a3f95e.gif[/img]

Dialogue Choices: Players will encounter dialogue choices that allow them to shape the story and Caly's relationship with the supporting cast. Some quests will put you squarely between two competing factions, and you must decide where you stand. Do you pledge your allegiance to the planetary defense force dedicated to eradicating slimes, or do you side with the mysterious slime people who have been forced to live in the sewers for centuries?

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/7c7a18d1b208cff5745cbb2b0699f8eb3d07a529.gif[/img]

Scenes: Traversing the world of Voidbound can lead you to both pleasurable and sticky situations. Just because Caly is trying to save Earth doesn't mean she doesn't deserve some fun now and then. In private or otherwise. Currently, there are over 40 hand-drawn erotic scenes in the game with more to come!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/f96386f29af85c6bd1b195d53a85128d4b25e7f8.png[/img]

Tactical Turn-based Combat: The grid-based battlefield allows for strategic tactical movement and combat engagements. Each skill has range that defines from how far you can attack or how far you need to stay away from your foes. Be careful if your outfit gets damaged, as enemies might alter their tactics and try to seduce Caly!

notes.title: VoidBound Hits Steam Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/84156af7bb4b5ee5ef0b6e97a51e0619ef9751d4.png[/img]
Hi everyone,

Voidbound is available now for Early Access on Steam with a launch discount of 15%! 

We at Cursed Atelier want to thank everyone who has supported the game's development so far. This is a momentous event and it wouldn't have been possible without your help and a lot of hard work and determination.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/3ztrpzW/Caly-change-standing-art.png[/img]
For anyone unfamiliar, VoidBound sees you playing as Caly, a sexy adorkable space merc who finds herself far from home in a strange galaxy.

The core gameplay will take you through harrowing tactical battles with our dynamic combat system.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/t2zVdmm/Combat-3.png[/img]
Besides tense encounters, Caly will explore incredible locations crafted with deep care and attention to detail to pull you into a breathtaking galaxy filled with powerful aliens, deadly robots, and more.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/9qWzRRS/chest-only-opens-from-the-side.png[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y2yPFTr/Combat-9.png[/img]
With that out of the way, we hope you'll suit up and dive into VoidBound and lead Caly through her adventure.

It has been a long journey to get to this point, but we like to think of this point as simply an exciting new chapter. Naturally, after the initial launch period, the team will be back to work on building new encounters and working toward the climactic ending of our sci-fi epic.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y7mYqvv/CG13-4-25.png[/img]
Until next time, see you in the stars!
Cursed-Atelier Team

Find Us @ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500710/VoidBound/

Adventurers,

Welcome back to our quick overview of VoidBound's development journey for the month of April.

Let's start with some art related updates:

-----

As the upcoming release draws nearer, our artist is diligently wrapping up the remaining concept tasks. At the forefront of these tasks are the robot defeat scenes, which have now entered the final stages of rendering.

In addition, the formidable mini-boss, The Warden, is poised to unleash chaos! His combat sprites and standing art have been fully prepared for implementation, with only a few finishing touches remaining on some combat assets.

Furthermore, significant strides have been made in the development of boss sprites and related CG works, and we're thrilled with the progress thus far.

-----

Meanwhile, our writers have been tweaking the Iron Maiden Scene to enhance its impact.

Additionally, we are revamping VoidBound's core description, which was conceived at the beginning of development. With the game's launch on Steam's Early Access approaching, it's the perfect time for a more polished introduction. Stay tuned for an updated overview!

Lastly, our efforts to improve and streamline tutorials, menus, and pages have continued throughout the week. Our goal is to ensure both new and returning players be able to easily navigate the game mechanics.

-----

Our latest alpha build, which includes nearly all new game elements, is currently undergoing rigorous testing. Thanks to the invaluable help and feedback from our community, we've identified and addressed various dialogue issues and unintended scenario loops.

Additionally, a range of new scenes have been implemented, including the Trap Scene (Iron Maiden), Stuck in Floor Trap Scene, and Conveyor Trap. Whether it's the bots' penchant for ambushing their foes or a reflection of the underground infrastructure's serious disrepair, Caly seems to get caught in some rather "naughty" scenarios pretty frequently.

-----

With that, we bid adieu to another week as well as another month of hard work on the game. A lot of things are set to unfurl in May with the impending Early Access launch, so we're definitely looking forward to bringing you those exciting unveils and updates!

Till then, take care and stay awesome~

Kind Regards,

Cursed-Atelier Team

notes.title: VoidBound Is Entering Steam Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/55ea0f6a5f636c2825889b7eea16f675269f6ea8.png[/img]
Greetings, Intrepid Void Explorers!

We're thrilled to share with you all that after years of hard work and dedication, VoidBound has passed STEAM's review process with flying colors!

This marks a significant milestone in the development journey of our game as the game will now move into [u][b]Early Access with the latest version available on May 24th! [/b][/u]

[u][b]What is Early Access? [/b][/u]

[i]Steam Early Access is a precursor stage that allows players to access and play games that are still in development. It's a unique opportunity for you to experience VoidBound firsthand, provide feedback, and be part of shaping its final version.[/i]

[u][b]Brief Overview of the Game and The Upcoming Update:[/b][/u]

For those who might be new to our community, VoidBound is a cosmic tale centered around Caly, a wayward Engineer forced to reckon with the realities of extra terrestrial lifeforms. Pulled into a strange galaxy, Caly must fight to survive against hostile aliens, sultry bounty hunters and more as she tries to find a way to find her path in her new extraordinary circumstances.

Envisioned at the dawn of 2020, VoidBound is a sci-fi RPG saga that that has gone through multiple revisions overtime. While the fundamental concept and story direction has largely remained unchanged, the graphics and game-play elements have been renewed and remade extensively.

Which brings us to the latest update that will go live on Steam come 24th!

[u][b]So, what will be new and what has changed?[/b][/u]

[list][*]Explore the Revamped Tripteen Dungeon: Embark on a thrilling odyssey through the completely overhauled Tripteen dungeon, now featuring a fresh layout, new challenges, and an engaging narrative filled with rich lore.

Prepare to delve deeper into its mysterious depths and encounter unique enemies![/list]
[list][*]Revamped Combat Mechanics: Discover new combat mechanics that add depth and excitement to battles. And yes, skills for both the player and enemy.[/list]
[list][*]Enhanced Tutorials: Experience fresh lessons with new intuitive tutorials, including a overhauled combat tutorial, to help you master the aforementioned new mechanics.[/list]
[list][*]New Cut-In Display: Immerse yourself in the action with a new cut-in display feature that enhances new combat visuals, and yes again, they are of the very naughty variety.[/list]
[list][*]Improved Loot System: Enjoy an enhanced loot system that rewards exploration and combat prowess, if you throw it down on the regular. If not..[/list]
[list][*]Introducing the Knockout System: Not a fan of brawl all the time? Not a problem! Introducing the new knockout system that will allow you to make quick work of random trash.. at the cost of less loot.[/list]
And more that we will detail on the eve of the Early Access release!!

[u][b]What's Next?[/b][/u]

Launching VoidBound on Steam has always been our primary goal, and we are thrilled to have reached this pivotal milestone. Our commitment to improving VoidBound remains steadfast—we will continue to follow our roadmap and elevate the game along its intended path.

For those who are still on the fence, you too can play a vital role in shaping the future of VoidBound. By purchasing the Early Access version on Steam, you not only support our development efforts but also gain the opportunity to contribute directly to the game's evolution.

[u][b]Thank You!![/b][/u]

On a final note, we'd like express our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you for believing in VoidBound and supporting our team through this journey. Your faith and enthusiasm is invaluable, to us and we can't wait to find out how it all unfolds as we near the finish line.

Let's embark on this final stretch, together.

Kind Regards,

Cursed-Atelier Team

Hello, everyone!

Welcome back to another edition of our weekly progress report. This one has a quite a bit to unpack, so lets get right into it!

-------

Continuing on the tasks from last week, new sprite work was developed for multiple NPCs, including for The Warden- formidable mini-boss of the Tripteen Underground.

Additionally, the Tripteen Normal Enemy Defeat scene has made significant strides and has reached the lineart stage.

The only things left for the Mini-Boss are the Combat standing art and Combat Cut-ins, which are now in the concept stages. For clarity, cut-ins are the in-combat images that show Caly's current state as she faces down her enemies.

And lastly, to enhance user experience, UI elements are being refined further, both in and out of combat. Expect a polished and streamlined visual layout that complements our game's immersive world!

------

The writing phase for the intense Iron Maiden Trap scene has been edited and completed!

Writers have now moved on to the new process of drafting the scene outline for the next chapter in Tripteen. This scene marks the final piece of the puzzle, and we're aiming to have the draft ready before the end of the month.

We're also enhancing and expanding our tutorial further. Our focus is to empower both old and new players to navigate VoidBound's intricate systems with ease. Expect detailed guidance on crafting essentials, including the creation of Suit Repair Kits and the application of Weapon Mods to Caly's arsenal.

------

Speaking of the tutorial, our coders have started working closely with the rest of the team developing a new guide segment for a smoother- more intuitive learning experience.

We've also added all the main coding for each separate stage of the Tripteen Dungeon bringing to life the twists and turns of the zone's challenging environment.

Additionally, coding work of our Mini-Boss encounter is now complete as well. Keep an eye out for this one as we're gearing up to integrate special cut-ins for Caly's epic battle with this formidable foe!

Enemies have also been strategically placed within the dungeon, and their patrol routes methodically set. With careful planning and observation, Caly can navigate around them to dodge them or spring a lethal ambush, which leads into the next update:

The New Looting System: Enemies now have a loot table that will drop items depending if you killed them in combat or eliminated them with a sneak attack. Engage in direct combat and be rewarded with more loot, or stealthily assassinate enemies for less rewards but time saved.

Finally, we're also in the process of deploying miscellaneous improvements to various gameplay mechanics including, but not limited to, Quest Log navigation, Movement Points, and the new struggle mechanic.

------

And that is all for this one! Thank you for joining us on this journey, and stay tuned for more exciting updates next week!

Kind Regards,

Cursed-Atelier Team

Inspiring new progress has been made with Caly's combat style! The new poses are shaping up nicely, and a significant portion of her 'nude' versions are ready to be implemented into the game as well!

New combat status effect pictures (clothing condition, restrained poses) are currently in the lineart stage as well.  

Every hero faces defeat occasionally, right? Well, we're embracing that truth with the development of a new Caly Defeat Scene. 

And hey, who knows, maybe some players lose on purpose – no judgment here! 😄

-----

This week we developed new interactions that'd transpire within the ominous Dungeon of Tripteen. We have added new puzzles to solve and traps to avoid, as well as a new narrative that focuses on the history of the area.

Additionally, our writers are reworking the early dialogues between Caly and crew to be more in sync with the new intro. 🖥️

-----

Finally, a new mechanic is in testing: Movement Points during combat! Currently moving around costs AP (Action Points), with this new system, it will now cost its own resource called MP (Movement Points). This will allow player to have much more freedom to both attack and move around much more freely.

We hope that this will help players develop their own unique playstyles!

And before we sign off, we're thrilled to announce the development of new speed settings for combat! With this feature, players will have the freedom to adjust the speed of combat according to their preferences. 

-----

And that is all for this one! Stay tuned for more updates in the next progress report. 

As always, thank you for supporting us. ❤️

Kind Regards,
Cursed-Atelier Team

As we go through another week of Voidbound development, join us in reflecting upon the groundwork for exciting features yet to come.

As always, lets begin with Art 🎨

Render tests on Section 2 are now largely finished with some minor work still remaining. Our current focus now shifts towards the third section of the dungeon map, followed by a final optimization pass across all three sections simultaneously.

Speaking of remaining tasks, we're still in the process of conceptualizing a select few scenarios, like that thrilling moment of Caly's daring fall on the conveyor belt that led to some... spicy developments 💓

We've also begun exploring innovative methods to enhance the visual allure of VoidBound, experimenting with new line-art techniques aimed at reducing production times while maintaining uncompromised quality.

Finally, in order to enhance player experience, we've revamped the Combat UI with streamlined engaging features like enemy info display, speeding up option, and dynamic cut-ins as well as combat poses.

--------

With ideas and concepts finalized, the story-writers are now deep in preparations, penning down the details and narrative text for puzzles and encounters throughout the dungeon, ensuring an immersive experience for the players.

Additionally, editing and fine-tuning of the colorful characters of Tripteen's base camp is now complete, adding depth and personality to the quaint little village.

--------

To deliver a well polished gaming experience, our coders are currently running rigorous testing on new dungeon mechanics as well as fine-tuning the intricacies of dungeon exploration. Our end goal to do so is to provide a challenging, yet rewarding gameplay experiences for our players 🎖️

In our last report, we emphasized our commitment to optimizing gameplay for all systems, and our coders have been diligently focused on cleaning up and optimizing plugins to achieve this goal. 

While OS compatibility is still a challenge, we remain steadfast in our aim to enhance hardware performance and ensure overall stability for all our players!

Ahoy Spacefarers,

From concept to code, the development journey continues! Let's peek under the hood and check out what got tackled this week 🖥️

Kicking off February, our artist and coder joined forces to put the new Tripteen maps through a gauntlet of technical tests. Each zone's visuals are now undergoing rigorous rendering analysis to strike that perfect balance between eye-catching aesthetics and smooth performance.
After-all, landscapes and intricate details are captivating, but meaningless if the game chugs along like a snail.

While developing VoidBound remains our top priority, fueling its launch with epic promo art is a close second! Stunning pieces are being crafted for Twitter to that effect, celebrating exciting milestones like reaching Wishlist goals, and if your reception is out of this world, they might just make a triumphant in-game debut! Prepare to be wowed! #VoidBoundArt 🐦

----

As we delve deeper into Tripteen's lore, we're re-imagining the backstory of Excite-O-Bot, the quirky droid in the village. 
[img]https://i.ibb.co/6mmLzqP/Screenshot-2024-02-08-050023.png[/img]
In the original concept, it was clear that its origins and the secrets are buried deep within the Tripteen Dungeon halls but, Caly never really stuck around to figure out more. This time however, not only are we expanding the Bot's story-line further, but we're also outlining a potential side quest for our intrepid heroine to tackle.

Players will be venturing deep into the dungeon's depths on Excite-O-Bot's request and perhaps, even re-discover more of the mysterious being's past in the process.

----

Finally, the new dungeon's lighting is getting its final touches! Expect ambience enhancing glows, dynamic ray casting effect, and maybe even some spooky flickering 🔦 to set the mood. These features are also undergoing stress tests and, if deemed necessary, will be optimized further in order to ensure maximum compatibility with a range of PC hardware. 

Tying it off, Tripteen's baddies are training for some serious battle! These new enemies and bosses are being equipped with a variety of unique skills, all based on the revamped combat system, that will require some strategic thinking to conquer. Fret not though, Caly will be fully armed with enough tools as well to pack more strategy than John Wick's bullets. 

It'll be a tactical dance, not a bullet ballet 💃🏻

And that concludes our update for this one. Thank you for reading until the end, nothing makes us happier. 

Take care and we'll see you in the next progress update.

[h2]January[/h2]
[list][*][h3]Full Render: The Dungeon Awaits 📐[/h3][/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/KjL64mB/Map-Floor-2-WIP.png[/img]
In January, we have dedicated most of our time on completely re-imagining Tripteen. As the first main dungeon players will encounter, we felt that Tripteen sorely needed a makeover to match the quality of the newly revamped intro.

Most notably, we updated the graphical visual of the dungeon to be on par with the most recent areas we developed. We showcased the new vision of one of the maps in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2500710/announcements/detail/3951412208273468828][b]Progress Report #97[/b][/url], as well as another map above.

With new stealth and light manipulation mechanics, players will be able to switch various lights on and off to reveal secret areas or hidden enemies lurking in the dark, and strategically use the light mechanics to their advantage.

Keep an eye out for future progress reports on the development of Tripteen!

[h3][list][*]Combat Clarity: Health Bars Unveiled 📊 (Work In Progress)[/list][/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/4pY8MzG/HP-Bars-UI-WIP.png[/img]
We are excited to announce two new additions to the combat system! Firstly, we added HP Bars for the enemies, to aid players in making efficient decisions based on the HP bar displayed next to each sprite.

The second addition is an info panel at the bottom of the screen that can be toggled on and off with a press of a button. This interface will showcase more detail than the HP bars, such as the numerical values of the enemies' current HP and total HP, to help players strategically plan their next move.

[h3][list][*] Weaponry Revamp: Mod Mania ⚙️[/list][/h3]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/tbWCPhM/Final-Mod-Presentation.gif[/img]
We have also been rethinking the weapon modifications to make the the existing weapon modding system more enjoyable and ultimately benefit the players in a meaningful way.

For instance, if you want to turn a single target attack into an area of effect attack, no problem! Want to turn a long range single shot into a piercing shot, go ahead! 👾 🔫

As the weapon modding is still in the concepting phase, we hope to reveal more information on this in the future progress reports! 

[h2]February[/h2]
[list][*] [h3]Penning Passion: H-Scene Symphony ✍️[/h3][/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/dLL0tL6/sketch.png[/img]
February will be the month where we heat things up with steamy H content.

To ensure that all our scenes are up to the same quality as our recent ones, we are going to re-render and also re-imagine the encounters Caly had in the Tripteen dungeon. Don't fret as nothing will be cut - the old scenes will be accessible in the gallery while the new rendered versions will be placed in the dungeon alongside some brand NEW scenes.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZKxxh3t/Sketch-Transition.gif[/img]
[i]We have a new artist on board! Our new artist will help with the lineart and sketching phase, working together with Doppel to bless VoidBound with more lewd art at a faster pace![/i]

[h2]March[/h2]

In March, we are aiming to release an update that will feature the entire first planet re-imagined. We are working hard in hopes that we can deliver the update with ample time for testing and bug fixing.

If time allows, we may add an additional scene to the update as well. 

[h2]Final Note: Beyond the Roadmap 🚀[/h2]

Lastly, we want to thank you for continuously supporting us throughout our journey to create VoidBound. 
We are excited for the updates we plan to make and are thrilled to share this Roadmap with you to showcase some of the big changes coming to the game. 

Stay tuned for future updates on our official channels! 🐦 And don't hesitate to reach out if you have questions, suggestions, or feedback for us.

With Well Wishes and Warm Regards,

Cursed-Atelier Team

Ahoy there, adventurers!

Ready to dive into 2024's first week of development progress? We've been hard at work forging the next chapter of VoidBound, and we're excited to share the latest plans from our creative treasure chest 🗃️
[b]
First up, updates from the artist:[/b]

Continuing our work from December, the Tripteen Maps are undergoing radical transformations! Our original designs, though befitting of an underground setting, still felt a bit too clean for a zone that is supposed to be occupied by aimless destructive bots. So, we decided to tear down the old walls and started sketching a brand new layout, one that strikes the perfect balance between expansive exploration and aesthetically suitable adventure.

Enter:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/MVPLbZ2/map-render-section-0-v3.png[/img]
[i]A preliminary sample showcasing the new layout with the unmaintained damage the facility suffered throughout the decades.[/i]

Overall, the concept of the map wings are in place, and now we're crafting the visual tapestry that will bring them to life. Think dilapidated floors, atmospherically dark ceilings in disrepair, and leaning walls with flickering lighting fixtures that whisper tales untold. And just like the captivating maps from the new intro, we plan on sprinkling interactable objects that add depth and discovery to every corner..- well at least to a few corners 😅

[b]Onwards to the write-.. [/b]😥

Our sincerest apologies for this section as we don't have anything of significance to report this time. The writer went off on a new year vacation in high spirits, only to return a bit worse for wear. Nothing worrying thankfully, but he will be doing some major catching up in the coming few days. Once again, Mea Culpa 🙇
[b]
Finally, some Code news:[/b]

While Tripteen continues to march towards its re-envisioned debut, we haven't lost sight of the bigger picture. In fact, the coding team has been diligently tinkering under the hood, focusing on areas that can truly elevate your gameplay experience.

Take for example, the weapon modification system. Remember those trusty sidearm mods and devastating rifle upgrades you've come to depend on? .. Anyone? Maybe? 😭 Well, we intend to remedy that by giving these accessories more bite by implementing changes to make upgrades impactful!

That means not just stat bumps, but adjusting foe skills as well, encouraging players to explore the modification system naturally. In the end, we feel that upgrades should feel exciting, meaningful, and like a game-changer in the heat of each unique battle 🌡️

And that is all for this one! Fret not though, this is just the first few chapters in our ongoing development saga! Stay tuned for more exciting updates in the weeks to come, as we refine mechanics, polish features, and make sure every aspect of VoidBound's newest patch is better than the original! 

Keep your eyes peeled, spacers, because the journey's just getting started 👩🏼‍🚀

Greetings, spacefaring allies🧑‍🚀

This week on the frontiers of intergalactic adventures, we've been weathering the holiday storm with grit and galactic glue. But, despite the festive distractions, our intrepid devs have been pushing the boundaries of our cosmic odyssey and we're here to share some of those bulletin updates with you. 

As always, lets start from the desk of the artist:

The jackhammering to the first planet continues as we blast its terrain with stunning new CG asset updates as well as additions of new robotic designs. Central among them is the tight focus on the Mini Boss who got some extra uplifts this week. 

Not only is the fight being re-done on a technical level to accommodate new tactics, its combat assets are being updated with new CG works as well. The idea is to create a unique and a formidable foe for Caly to go up against as she starts out her adventures. Goes without saying, the loss scene associated with the mini-boss is getting a grand re-design as well so expect Caly to get "machine"-handled in a variety of new ways.

Overall, after closely evaluating our initial work on the game, we're convinced that a quality overhaul of some earlier portions of the game is in order. Not only that, but we'll also be looking through existing CGs all around the game and make the needed adjustments to bring them more in line with the current standard. 

The word weavers kept themselves busy reworking the Tripteen story-line. Their absolute priority is to avoid text droning while still keeping the lore engaging, though details remain sparse at this point. However, it was confirmed that new points of interests will be added with the rework to keep player explorations interesting so, safe to presume the new rework will have significant game-play highlights as well.

Finally, a new feature update from our coder who is in the middle of developing a new “Population System”. Henosis is a bustling metropolitan space hub and its multiple large zones are a testament to that claim..- except the bustling part really doesn't show as zones tend to feel a bit empty. We intend to remedy that by adding a system that will populate crowds. Aliens from all walks of life will stroll along the streets and hallways, making it feel like a proper intergalactic hub of hustle and bustle.

And that is all for this one. Development arc dipped a tab bit this week due to the holidays but we fully intend to recover our groove once we enter the new year so stay tuned for new things in 2024!

Till then though, thanks for reading and your time.

Cursed-Atelier Team

notes.title: Progress Report #95: December 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/c634891aab1b661c4d2ced5c9164dfbc5745a0b6.png[/img]
Hey there, Spacers

It feels like this year has been turned onto megadrive speed, hasn't it? As we get close to the holidays the team has been working steadily so that we ride out the end of the year in style. Our last game update is available to our Patreons, but we've still got plenty of stuff to talk about for our next game update that will come out in the new year.

If you've been following closely, you know that our artist outdid themself with some amazing Celebration Images, showing off Caly in a sexy new number that we will have to bring into the game somehow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/5126baa68143761973292445e76859a5cf32ec41.png[/img]

Beyond our new Celebration and Fan Art images, the artist has also been hard at work drafting the new dungeon layout for Tripteen. This involves creating new enemies and a miniboss, as well as a few crafty traps to pump on the danger in the first dungeon that Caly will be exploring on her path of adventure.

Storywise, we're happy to report that we have a new outline structured for the end of the Tripteen Foundry dungeon. Beyond planning things out from start to finish, we're also looking to revisit the final boss of the dungeon.

They're a pretty strong contender and a memorable design, so we had fun making sure we can keep the main elements intact as we move to improve Tripteen. We've also been exploring the 'story' of the dungeon, looking for ways to add additional details and motifs to turn it into a fully-fledged location worthy of exploration and not just running and gunning to get to the loot. Not that there won't be some treasure hidden throughout the new map.

When everything is locked in, it should not only be an interesting and challenging dungeon to enjoy, but you'll also be able to learn a bit more about the Eeker's who created the Foundry, to begin with, and what happened to make the place the ruins that Caly finds when she begins her journey.

Last but not least, our code workers have been dialing in the approach to use our lighting system to create added challenges in dungeons and other maps. This is a big thing, and it covers areas like utilizing light and darkness to distract Caly's enemies. Perhaps we may be able to code in a blinding effect for some creatures so that Caly can blind them and then run away from them, or enter into combat with them in a weakened state.

Caly is an engineer, after all, and what better way to show off her mechanical skills than using her technical know-how to get a major edge on a boss, or maybe skip them altogether?

We've also started a basic look at a potential card game for Henosis. Rescuing Earth is important, but it can wait a little longer when that perfect hand comes along, right? We're far from giving out more details about it, but you can trust that the finished card game will include both a SFW and NSFW version.

And that is all she wrote. Thanks for stopping by to check out our newest progress and have a great weekend!

Kind Regards, Cursed-Atelier Team

Hey there, fellow spacers!

Another December week flown by in the trenches of game development. With coffee in hand, keyboard constantly click-clacking, and inspiration overflowing the team remains busy plugging away at new challenges at hand- and it's all made possible thanks to your incredible support!

Without adieu, to this week's highlights:

The artist kicked things off by starting with the redesign of the cryptic machines of Tripteen. These automatons patrol the deep dungeon halls with an ant worker like purpose- or at least that is how they were patterned to be originally. Now however, their actions seem senseless at best. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/sKg8Wtd/Bot-Concept-Rework.png[/img]
[i]Maybe because their circuits got fried over time? Or they simply are no longer receiving control directions? Still, they remain an unpredictably dangerous force to reckon with.[/i]

Over 8 designs made in this new concept art for Tripteen's Revamp. These bots cover a wide range of shapes and sizes and will offer up a buffet of metallic enemies for Caly to contend with. The best thing is since they're bots, we might see their designs pop up later. Though, it still remains to be seen if all designs will make the final cut or not. Jens says Henosis is prime for more robots.

Additionally, the dungeon's new structure is being reformed as well. We played with different ideas, new and old and though the core structure of the facility will always have a place in our memories, we hope this new dungeon will show off the evolution of the game's development.

With new map designs, also come new planned features- some of which we're testing out extensively to gauge their impact in the long run. And while the overall story may be close to the original, new puzzles and findable will give the Tripteen Dungeon the same freshness the Introduction received.

Finally, our code-workers report that they have begun preemptive work on accommodating the changes that will come with the rework. This includes rearranging current visual assets while revamping other concepts to bring it more in line with the recent quality releases. It's about time we replaced our three year old map-work with a more pristinely modern parallax creation. 

Part of this effort also includes re-balancing the enemy skill-sets. With the bots becoming diversely unique, their capabilities are now under re-evaluation as well- something we predict will noticeably change the way players will approach these fights, in comparison to the original.

And that is our entire showcasing for this one. Concept planning has always been slow, but we're hopeful we'll have a clear vision of everything we intend to achieve before the holiday season  really kicks in.

But, that's for later. For now, thanks for reading and your time. We'll see you in the next one o/

Kind Regards,

Cursed-Atelier Team

Hi everyone,

Another week down, and another mountain of progress climbed! With two major releases now behind us, we're now excited to share with you the plans we have for the future. Buckle up and let's dive in!

First, lets start with the CG works that saw the addition of the new sprites, spacesuits and GUI of the Quest Log itself. The last one in particular was finished just in time to be released in 0.5.6 Release but, the team decided to not keep such a requested feature exclusive and continued working hard these last few days to push it in our 0.5.5 Release as well. Hopefully, it meets your expectations and then some as we collect more feedback data around it.

But the biggest one was the commissioning of new zone rework.

[b]This time, Caly's first alien planet destination: [u]Tripteen[/u][/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/zRCVdsP/Tripteen.png[/img]
[i]An ideal candidate for revamping to our current standards as the original was conceived nearly three years ago! [/i]

In essence, our main focus and priority is to enhance the exploration side of the planet as it is the first key area players visit and get to properly stretch their legs and explore around at their own leisure. To that effect, a few ideas are being bounced around currently that include, but not limited to: 

[list]
[*]Expanding the zone itself to add more gameplay oriented features.
[*]Rework the CGs extensively for markedly improved experience while traversing the village as well as the dungeon environment
[*]Update the looks as well as the function of NPCs as well the Bots so they feel more principally important in the grand scheme of things
[/list] and more!

Unfortunately, as the entire rework is in its infancy stage, we don't have much eye-candy to regale you with currently, but we promise to keep you updated on this front as more develops.

Finally, boomeranging back to both the Alpha and Public builds- with their releases out of the way, the coders busied themselves absorbing the feedback data and incorporating quality of life improvement changes as well as deploying bug troubleshooting solutions. Essentially, this marks the precursor to establishing a stable build, that once ready, will become the bedrock for the next offshoot mobile build in the future.

And that is it for this one. While there's still much to be done, we're committed to achieving our vision for VoidBound by continuing to rebuild the old while simultaneously creating something interestingly new and novel. As such, in the coming weeks, we'll be focusing on polishing existing features as well as implementing new content, so stay tuned for further updates!
